single-strip.visualEvidence: The upper-left ring is on the diagonal and the second ring is in the uncovered right rectangle. Unfolding the horizontal half-fold gives holes in the top and bottom of column 1 and the two middle cells of column 3. C shows both pairs; D moves the middle pair to column 4. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.

parallel-same.visualEvidence: The first two panels show successive strips turning down from the top. From left to right the final three rings are on the diagonal, inside the triangular flap and outside it. Undoing the middle ring adds a reflected hole whose stack restores rows 1 through 3 in column 2. B shows those rows and the row-4 triplet. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.

parallel-opposed.visualEvidence: Operation 1 moves the left strip rightward, then operation 2 moves the right edge leftward. Three rings line up in column 4, one on the diagonal. The recovered columns are 1, 4 and 5 on rows 2, 3 and 4. A has precisely those three rows; D adds row 1. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.

crossed-strips.visualEvidence: The first footprint loses its lower two rows and the second loses its left two columns. The top-right ring lies on the diagonal. Only C has four consecutive holes from the left in the first row and exactly two centered left-of-middle holes in both rows 3 and 4. The other panels remove, add or move a column. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.

crease.visualEvidence: The red ring lies exactly on the rising diagonal in row 2, column 2. The right-hand strip folds left, so the two restored holes lie in columns 2 and 3 of the middle row. Only D shows both there. B is visibly empty. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.

flap.visualEvidence: The red ring lies above the descending diagonal inside the triangular flap. Undoing it adds the reflected middle-left hole. Undoing the bottom strip contributes the lower-left hole. D has those two and the top-middle hole; B moves the left pair to the right. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.

outside.visualEvidence: The red ring is above the horizontal edge of the corner flap. The first vertical fold places the two left columns together, so both holes reappear on the top row. A has exactly that pair; C copies the pair one row lower. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.

multiple.visualEvidence: The upper-left ring is on the diagonal and the second ring is in the uncovered right rectangle. Unfolding the horizontal half-fold gives holes in the top and bottom of column 1 and the two middle cells of column 3. C shows both pairs; D moves the middle pair to column 4. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.

row-band.visualEvidence: The red ring lies exactly on the rising diagonal in row 2, column 2. The right-hand strip folds left, so the two restored holes lie in columns 2 and 3 of the middle row. Only D shows both there. B is visibly empty. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.

column-band.visualEvidence: The red ring lies above the descending diagonal inside the triangular flap. Undoing it adds the reflected middle-left hole. Undoing the bottom strip contributes the lower-left hole. D has those two and the top-middle hole; B moves the left pair to the right. The final caption states the allowed fold directions.
